name: Daily challenge displays deterministic problem and submits user choice
description: User opens Treino Mental, locates the Daily Challenge card, selects an answer option and verifies the submission response.

planSteps.description: Click on the Treino Mental tab in the top navigation bar
Click on the first multiple choice option button in the Desafio Diário card
Click the Confirmar Resposta button to submit the daily challenge answer
Verify the daily challenge displays the completion feedback status and solution explanation
